summary: Scans a table of constant entries starting at this+16 (array base at offset 0x40, count this[15] at offset 0x3C). Each entry is a pointer whose +4 DWORD is a type ID: type 0 terminates the scan, type 1 selects a2[10], type 5 selects a2[12], and any other non-zero type selects a2[11]. Returns 1 as soon as the selected float is non-zero; returns 0 when the table is empty, the scan exhausts the count, or all selected values are zero. On the per-frame tick path, invoked by sub_4EE2D0 (004EE2D0).

local_names.v2: entry count of the constant table (this[15])
local_names.i: entry-cursor pointer into the table (starts at this + 16)
local_names.v7: candidate float selected by type (a2[10], a2[11] or a2[12])

operations.description: Identity: char __thiscall sub_4CE380(_DWORD *this, float *a2); ABI label 'Float Comparison with Constants Table' (LEGACY); packet marks on_frame_path
v2 = this[15] (offset 0x3C): load the entry count of the constant table
When the entry count is non-positive (v2 <= 0), return 0: no entries to scan
Iterate entries starting at this + 16 (entry array base at offset 0x40); each element is a pointer, and the type ID is read at entry+4 (offset 0x4 within the object pointed to by this[16])
When the type ID is 0, break the scan (entry terminator)
Select the candidate float by type ID: type 1 reads a2[10], type 5 reads a2[12], any other non-zero type reads a2[11]
When the selected candidate float is zero, continue to the next entry; when the index reaches the count, return 0
Return 1 as soon as a non-zero candidate float is found
